name: FasterTransformer
notable_features: Custom multi-GPU / multi-node kernels with fused GEMM + softmax + sampling
Vendor fork with INT8 quantization paths; was the default reference serving stack before vLLM
hardware_caveats: Successor path is TensorRT-LLM; FasterTransformer is now maintenance-mode at NVIDIA
best_for: offline / static-batch throughput on NVIDIA GPUs
avoid_for: low-latency interactive serving - no continuous batching
notes: The 'TensorRT-LLM-based inference server' in the Databricks best-practices post, and the baseline engine in the vLLM PagedAttention paper and in the SmoothQuant paper (which integrates SmoothQuant into FasterTransformer for its INT8 speed claims). Recorded so benchmark records can point at an engine id instead of free-text engine names. SmoothQuant's 1.56x speedup over FP16 is a FasterTransformer INT8 result, NOT a vLLM or TensorRT-LLM result. ||| MAINTENANCE (dated fact, GitHub API, 2026-10-04): last commit 2023-10-19 (35.5 months before this record), latest release release/v5.3_tag published 2023-01-23, 40 contributors (distinct committers including anonymous), open_issues_count 288 (issues PLUS pull requests - see [[ev-github-open-issues-count-includes-pull-requests]]), not archived, 6457 stars.
